After the verbs द्युत् 'to shine' etc., the terminations of the परस्मैपद are optionally employed, when the affixes of लुण् (Aorist) follow.

Terms: परस्मैपद

After the words 1. दिव् 2. प्राच् 3. अपाच् 4. उदच् and 5. प्रत्यच् , the affix यत् is added in the remaining senses.

Terms: यत्

The affix म comes in the sense of मतुप् after 1. द्यु and 2. द्रु ।

Terms: म

There is vocalisation of the half-vowel of the reduplicate of द्युत् and स्वापि (Causative of स्वप्).

Terms: Reduplicate
